newsitem.title: LATVIA: FOCUS - DEALERS DIVIDED ON VILNIAUS BANK RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS - DEALERS DIVIDED ON VILNIAUS BANK RESULTS.

text.p: Vilniaus Bank's half-year results, released on Monday, beat market expectations but dealers were divided on the impact they would have on the bank's share price.
Vilniaus said its unaudited net profit for the first six months of the year was 21.4 million litas compared with 11.7 million litas for the same period last year.
It said it did not expect the final audited figures to change and that it saw no need to change its profit forecast of 39 million litas.
The bank's share price rose to 240 litas from 231 litas on Monday ahead of the result.
"This result was above expectations," said Arvydas Jacakevichius, a broker with Suprema.
"The bank may not have changed its profit forecast but that is because it is very conservative. These numbers suggest it could exceed its profit forecast for this year," he said.
But he added the result may not have a big effect on the bank's share price.
"It should have a positive impact on its price but it might not. The bank may have looked overpriced before and now its price may look just right," he said.
"It was a very good result, but not much higher than the market anticipated," said another dealer.
"The bank's price is about right so it shouldn't rise much more," he added.
"I view this profit as very big and positive for the bank and its shares," said one dealer.
"The price is already rising and there is a big order for its shares today," he said.
"It should rise some more this week and will probably increase further next week," he added.
The bank, the largest private commercial bank in Lithuania, was in relative demand on the sluggish bourse last week, turning over 5.37 million litas in block trades.

Its main rival, Hermis Bank, saw its share price climb 10 percent to 203.50 litas last week and its price jumped to 210 litas on Monday despite a first-half result which fell a bit short of market expectations.
But Hermis Bank said it was sticking to its profit forecast of 40.6 million litas for 1997.
